title: Dropshippers Get Rich by Making You Feel Poor
summary: Paywalled article teaser: dropshipping influencers sell courses by making viewers feel poor, and teaching the scheme pays better than running it.

assertions.quote: Teaching people how to sell stuff is a lot more profitable than actually selling it.
Dropshippers Get Rich by Making You Feel Poor
Hundreds of influencers claim the path to a fancy lifestyle is selling cheap crap from China.
